trickyParts: The live lane is a second bus.Client (one core subscription per client) in queue group envoy-listener-live-<machine>, never the role lane's group, which NATS would merge across subjects.
The live wrapper filters on msg.Subject before decoding (role lanes and StreamCaptures subjects dropped), and only for liveDelivery drops an envelope whose Topic differs from its subject.
A refused live subscribe is detected by Flush then Conn.LastError() errors.Is ErrPermissionViolation; the start exits 1.

Docker is absent in the pod: listener/bus/session tests ran locally through a go -overlay of internal/testnats that starts a local nats-server ($TMPDIR/overlay, never committed); tests needing Postgres or container stop/pause are CI-only.

nats.go v1.50.0 keeps a refused subscription valid (permissionsErr is unexported); the bus marks the core registration refused from the async error callback (subject+queue for 'using queue', subject alone for the reload form '(sid "n")') and clears it on every re-send (onReconnect, a bind); nats.go queues the reconnect callback before any -ERR for the re-sent SUB, so ordering holds.

Main took #2189 (in-process testnats) while round 1 was in review; the forward merge bd2b1350 takes main's testnats and re-adds SubscribeGrantConfig and Server.Restart on it. Tests now run in the pod with no overlay; TestDispatch* (Postgres) and the infra live grant tests (Docker images) remain CI-only.
